description: A shell script for managing application downloads, extraction, installation, verification, and uninstallation within a device management system. It handles multiple versions, signature verification, and cleanup processes.

methods.name: downloadApp
methods.description: Downloads the application package to the download directory.

methods.name: extractApp
methods.description: Extracts application bundle and package files, performs sanity checks.

methods.name: installApp
methods.description: Installs application files to the designated directory, fetching metadata and package contents.

methods.name: verifyAppSignature
methods.description: Verifies the application's signature using an external script.

methods.name: postVerifyInstall
methods.description: Performs post-installation steps like copying metadata and executing install scripts.

methods.name: uninstallApp
methods.description: Removes application directories for specified app and version.

methods.name: updatePkgStatus
methods.description: Updates the package status and broadcasts it.

methods.name: updatePackage
methods.description: Coordinates download, extraction, installation, verification, and cleanup for a specific package version.
